zh.thesis: 通过逆向DRAM地址变换，可以访问被硬件隔离的受保护内存，瓦解依赖它的安全机制。
paragraphs: 该研究利用AMD Family 16h数据手册中公开的DRAM控制器变换寄存器，通过别名映射重写物理地址翻译，从而访问平台安全处理器（PSP）、系统管理模式（SMM）等隐藏区域。这些区域原本对内核不可见，但如今可被任意读写。
方法基于对通道间、存储体间交错和XOR加扰的逆向，使用GF(2)伪逆恢复别名映射。测试中成功从SMM内存提取了SMI处理程序入口，并转储了CC6状态下各核心的架构上下文，证明隔离的有效性取决于对DRAM变换的保密。
该技术不仅限于AMD，Intel、ARM、RISC-V等架构均采用类似的内存控制器变换，意味着依赖DRAM隔离的SGX、TrustZone等安全技术都可能受影响。此研究开启了硬件安全新战场，但尚未公布所有细节。

en.thesis: By reverse-engineering DRAM address translation, protected memory that is hardware-isolated can be accessed, undermining the security mechanisms that rely on it.
paragraphs: This research exploits publicly documented DRAM controller scrambling registers from AMD's Family 16h datasheet. By rewriting physical address translation through alias mapping, the researchers gain access to hidden regions such as the Platform Security Processor (PSP) and System Management Mode (SMM). These areas were previously invisible to the kernel but can now be read and written arbitrarily.

The method is based on reversing the interleaving between channels and banks as well as the XOR scrambling, using a GF(2) pseudo-inverse to recover the alias mapping. In testing, they successfully extracted the SMI handler entry from SMM memory and dumped the architectural context of each core in the CC6 state, proving that the effectiveness of isolation depends on the secrecy of the DRAM transformation.

This technique is not limited to AMD; architectures such as Intel, ARM, and RISC-V employ similar memory controller transformations, meaning security technologies like SGX and TrustZone that rely on DRAM isolation could be affected. This research opens a new battlefield in hardware security, though not all details have yet been released.

articles.title: The Quest For Caffeine You Can Have At Night
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 夜间咖啡因替代品中，帕拉黄嘌呤最安全有效，但效果因人而异。
paragraphs: 咖啡因经肝脏酶CYP1A2代谢，半衰期约5小时，产物帕拉黄嘌呤再代谢，实际刺激持续约15小时。想要晚间饮用不影响睡眠，可调节酶、代谢物或起始物。
吴茱萸碱（rutaecarpine）可诱导CYP1A2，加速分解，但可能伤肝。帕拉黄嘌呤直接服用半衰期3小时，安全性高，但反应不一。甲基金雀花碱（methylliberine）半衰期1.5小时，效果更不稳定。
结论：帕拉黄嘌呤是首选，推荐剂量50-200毫克，最大300-400毫克。甲基金雀花碱适合对帕拉黄嘌呤无效者，吴茱萸碱仅用于紧急情况，因肝损伤风险应避免。

en.thesis: Among nighttime caffeine substitutes, paraxanthine is the safest and most effective, but individual responses vary.
paragraphs: Caffeine is metabolized by the liver enzyme CYP1A2, with a half-life of about five hours, and its product paraxanthine is further metabolized, so the actual stimulant effect lasts around fifteen hours. To enjoy a drink in the evening without disrupting sleep, one can modulate the enzyme, the metabolite, or the starting compound.

Rutaecarpine can induce CYP1A2, accelerating caffeine breakdown, but it may harm the liver. Taking paraxanthine directly has a half-life of three hours, is quite safe, yet reactions vary among individuals. Methylliberine has a half-life of one and a half hours, making its effect even more inconsistent.

In conclusion, paraxanthine is the top choice, with recommended doses of 50 to 200 milligrams, and a maximum of 300 to 400 milligrams. Methylliberine suits those who do not respond to paraxanthine, while rutaecarpine should be reserved for emergencies and ideally avoided due to the risk of liver damage.

articles.title: My very interesting Conversation with Daron Acemoglu
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 左翼自由主义因自身建制化失败而衰落，需以有意义自由为基础重建共识。
paragraphs: 在与库恩的对话中，阿西莫格鲁以古罗马类比，指左翼自由主义近八十年掌权未善用建制权力，致内部脆弱，难抗外部威权挑战，故今日思想争锋如十九世纪初。
他拒斥客观主义，认为真理与道德均渐进演化，尤重有意义自由——非仅免于干预，而是需社区保障机会，防止强者支配。其方案无统一标准，亦不采功利权衡，留下多元价值冲突之悬而未决。

en.thesis: Left-wing liberalism has declined because it failed to institutionalize its power, and needs to rebuild consensus on the basis of meaningful freedom.
paragraphs: In his conversation with Kuhn, Acemoglu draws an analogy with ancient Rome, arguing that left-wing liberalism, having held power for nearly eight decades without properly using institutional power, has become internally fragile and unable to withstand external authoritarian challenges. Hence, today's intellectual contest resembles that of the early nineteenth century.

He rejects objectivism, holding that truth and morality evolve gradually. He particularly emphasizes meaningful freedom—not merely freedom from interference, but freedom that requires community safeguards to ensure opportunities and prevent domination by the strong. His approach has no uniform standard and does not adopt utilitarian trade-offs, leaving unresolved the conflicts among plural values.

articles.title: Medicare for All should be more like Medicare
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 全民医保的口号不该照搬加拿大模式，而应更像现有美国联邦医保计划，才能赢得温和选民。
paragraphs: 「全民医保」的吸引力在于借用已有的、受欢迎的「联邦医保」之名，且公众在原则上反对医疗由市场决定。但具体政策不能止于口号，各国模式各异，美国左翼提案实为加拿大式单一支付体系。
作者主张，既然口号借力于现有联邦医保的声誉，那么方案应更贴近该计划的实际设计：覆盖范围有限、有自付额与共付，而非提供无限免费服务。这样既保留道德诉求，又具备可行性和政治吸引力。

en.thesis: The 'Medicare for All' slogan should not copy the Canadian model but instead resemble the existing US federal Medicare program to win over moderate voters.
paragraphs: The appeal of 'Medicare for All' lies in borrowing the name of the popular, existing 'Medicare' program, and the public opposes, in principle, having healthcare determined by the market. But specific policy cannot stop at a slogan; models vary across countries, and the US left-wing proposal is essentially a Canadian-style single-payer system.

The author argues that since the slogan draws on the reputation of the existing Medicare program, the proposal should be closer to that program's actual design: with limited coverage, deductibles, and copayments, rather than unlimited free services. This would retain its moral appeal while being feasible and politically attractive.

zh.thesis: 重读《独自打保龄》发现其预言准确，但核心机制仍模糊，且电视的作用被低估。
paragraphs: 作者曾假装读过此书，却在作者任教的大学亲历其争论。如今重读，他惊讶于书中对教会衰败和互联网无法替代人际交往的预测竟被证实。
合著者耶路撒冷则批评其因果链混乱，认为这属于对自由主义的保守反弹。双方一致认为，电视造成社交资本近半下降，但书中着墨甚少，解决方案也回避此点。
这引发疑问：是社交减少本身，还是视频内容导致不良后果？播客中深入探讨了这些议题。

en.thesis: Revisiting 'Bowling Alone' finds its predictions accurate, but the core mechanism remains vague, and the role of television is underappreciated.
paragraphs: The author once pretended to have read the book, yet he experienced its controversies firsthand at a university where he teaches. Now, on a reread, he is struck by how its predictions about declining church attendance and the internet's failure to replace face-to-face interaction have come true.

Co-author Jerusalem criticizes its muddled causal chain, viewing it as a conservative backlash against liberalism. Both agree that television accounts for nearly half of the decline in social capital, yet the book gives it scant attention and its solutions sidestep this issue.
This raises the question: is it the reduction in socializing itself, or the content of video, that leads to adverse outcomes? These issues are explored in depth in the podcast.

articles.title: Google recommends these 7 NotebookLM prompts, and they showed me what I was missing
articles.author: Mahnoor Faisal

zh.thesis: Google 推荐的七个 NotebookLM 提示词显示其从阅读工具转向全能代理，但学生功能仍显不足。
paragraphs: 作者长期使用 NotebookLM，新提示词分学生、商务、个人三类。学生向的生成测验和 PDF 指南虽便捷，但局限于旧功能。
商务提示词要求计算营收趋势和搜索竞品，体现云端代码执行与联网代理的新能力。个人向则把收据变成表格、分析房产投资，但作者对部分更新仍失望。

en.thesis: Google's seven recommended NotebookLM prompts reveal its shift from a reading tool to an all-purpose agent, but student features still fall short.
paragraphs: The author, a long-time NotebookLM user, found that the new prompts fall into three categories: student, business, and personal. The student-oriented prompts for generating quizzes and PDF guides are convenient, but they only scratch the surface of the old functionality.

Business prompts require calculating revenue trends and searching for competitors, showcasing the new capabilities of cloud-based code execution and web-connected agents. Personal prompts turn receipts into tables and analyze real estate investments, yet the author still feels disappointed with some of the updates.

articles.title: I Deleted My Calendar Link. And I’m Never Going Back
articles.author: JA Westenberg

zh.thesis: 删除日历链接、恢复人工协调，是夺回时间自主权的必要反叛。
paragraphs: 作者曾依赖Calendly等自动预约工具，但发现它把稀缺时间变成无限自选购物，任由他人自私占用，导致会议泛滥、效率低下。
于是删除链接，回归邮件往返协调。虽然费力，但迫使双方明确会议目的、必要性及优先级，过滤掉无意义会议，让时间回归自己的掌控。

en.thesis: Deleting the calendar link and returning to manual coordination is a necessary rebellion to reclaim autonomy over one's time.
paragraphs: The author once relied on automatic scheduling tools like Calendly, but discovered that they turned scarce time into an endless self-service buffet, allowing others to selfishly claim it, leading to a flood of meetings and inefficiency.

So they deleted the link and went back to coordinating via email back-and-forth. Though more laborious, it forces both parties to clarify the purpose, necessity, and priority of a meeting, filtering out meaningless ones and bringing time back under one's own control.

articles.title: New York is building. But where?
articles.author: Halina Bennet

zh.thesis: 纽约市长 Mamdani 的 pied-à-terre 税遭法院叫停，显示高价值二套房征税的政治阻力。
paragraphs: 纽约市长 Mamdani 的 pied-à-terre 税（对高价值二套房征税）周一被 Staten Island 法官 Wayne Ozzi 暂停。这一裁决紧随该政策宣布之后，显示行政推动遭遇司法障碍。
此外，文章还提及圣地亚哥的 YIMBY 市长与 wildfire 流离失所后的恢复，但正文被付费墙截断，细节有限。整体信息密度低，但涉及城市住房政策博弈，归类为商业。

en.thesis: A Staten Island judge has blocked Mayor Mamdani's pied-a-terre tax on high-value second homes, revealing the political resistance to taxing such properties.
paragraphs: A Staten Island judge, Wayne Ozzi, on Monday halted Mayor Mamdani's pied-a-terre tax, which targets high-value second homes. The ruling comes hot on the heels of the policy's announcement, showing that executive momentum has hit a judicial roadblock.

The piece also touches on San Diego's YIMBY mayor and recovery after wildfire displacement, though the full text is paywalled and details are scant. Overall, the information density is low, but it touches on urban housing policy battles and is classified as business.

zh.thesis: 在科技界随大流是死路，坚守信念而非迎合共识才是真正的护城河。
paragraphs: 作者批判科技圈千篇一律的成功模板，主张个人应像异端一样坚持自己的判断。论点基于对行业同质化的观察，而非数据。
文中以星巴克等为例，说明反直觉决策的价值。但付费墙后内容有限，论证多靠煽动性口号，缺乏具体机制。
若成立，则个人品牌应重信念而非技能。但整体更像励志演讲，深度不足，对普通读者启发有限。

en.thesis: In tech, following the crowd is a dead end; holding firm to your convictions rather than conforming to consensus is the true moat.
paragraphs: The author criticizes the cookie-cutter success templates prevalent in the tech world, arguing that individuals should stick to their own judgments like heretics. The argument is based on observations of industry homogenization, not data.

Using examples like Starbucks, the piece illustrates the value of counterintuitive decisions. However, the content behind the paywall is limited, and the reasoning often relies on provocative slogans rather than concrete mechanisms.

If valid, it suggests that personal brands should prioritize conviction over skill. Yet overall, it reads more like a motivational speech than a deep analysis, offering limited inspiration for the average reader.

zh.thesis: Gemini 3.7 Flash作为新型工作模型，在编码和智能体任务上性能大幅提升，且价格减半。
paragraphs: 谷歌发布Gemini 3.7 Flash，距3.6仅三周，针对开发者反馈优化。在编码调试、问题解决上显著进步，首遍代码准确率更高，FrontierCode 1.1 Main得分43.6%对34.4%。
知识密集型领域如金融、法律、生物科学推理增强，GDP.pdf基准34%对22%，AutomationBench 30.4%对17%。Web开发生成更实用布局，WebDev Arena Elo 1588对1538。
输入价格每百万token 0.75美元，输出3.75美元，为原3.6 Flash一半。同时更新Gemini Spark，提升工具使用效率。安全方面强化了CBRN和网络攻击防护。

en.thesis: Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new working model, delivers major gains in coding and agentic tasks at half the price.
paragraphs: Google has released Gemini 3.7 Flash, a mere three weeks after 3.6, with improvements aimed at developer feedback. It shows notable progress in coding, debugging, and problem-solving, with higher first-attempt code accuracy, scoring 43.6% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main versus 34.4% for its predecessor.

Reasoning in knowledge-intensive domains like finance, law, and biosciences is enhanced, with scores on GDP.pdf jumping from 22% to 34%, and on AutomationBench from 17% to 30.4%. Web development output also yields more practical layouts, lifting its WebDev Arena Elo from 1538 to 1588.

Pricing is set at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, half the cost of the original 3.6 Flash. At the same time, Gemini Spark has been updated for better tool-use efficiency, and safety measures have been reinforced against CBRN and cyberattack threats.

zh.thesis: 模仿长尾猴叫声正被印度人用作驱赶猕猴的职业，且需求上升。
paragraphs: 为迎接德里羽毛球世锦赛，印度人专职模仿长尾猴叫声来驱赶猕猴，因这种声音是唯一有效威慑。
这些专业人员受雇于害虫防治领域，反映服务业中非传统技能的价值。
伴随活动安保需求，此类声音模仿职业可能更普遍，显示创造力在就业中的作用。

en.thesis: The imitation of the long-tailed macaque's call is being used by Indians as a profession to scare away monkeys, and demand for this service is on the rise.
paragraphs: In preparation for the Delhi Badminton World Championships, Indians are being hired specifically to mimic the calls of long-tailed macaques to deter the resident monkeys, as this sound is the only effective deterrent.
These specialists are employed within the pest control sector, reflecting the value of unconventional skills in the service industry.
With the security needs of such events, this kind of vocal mimicry profession may become more common, highlighting the role of creativity in employment.

zh.thesis: 一篇链接合集，论点薄弱，胜在覆盖面广。
paragraphs: 这是典型的链接汇总，每条附带一句评论。从用AI六天写论文并记录过程，到医学未来「每个疾病都是政策失败」，再到中国监管AI伴侣，内容松散。
作为信息源，它提示了当下热点：AI辅助科研的元研究、政策失败论、以及AI伴侣监管的起步。但缺乏深入论证，价值在于索引而非分析。

en.thesis: A link collection with thin argumentation, but broad coverage.
paragraphs: This is a typical roundup of links, each with a one-line comment. From a six-day experiment in writing a thesis with AI, to the medical future where 'every disease is a policy failure', to China's regulation of AI companions, the items are loosely connected.

As a source of information, it highlights current hot topics: meta-research on AI-assisted scholarship, the policy-failure thesis, and the early stages of AI companion regulation. But it lacks deep argumentation, its value lying more as an index than as analysis.

zh.thesis: DeepSeek Harness 以「一切皆插件」架构开放开发者预览，强调可组合与可追溯。
paragraphs: DeepSeek 发布 Harness 开发者预览，宣称所有能力——模型、工具、技能、会话、沙箱、存储、循环、调度、UI——皆为可替换插件，基于 Cordis 插件系统。
架构让开发者无需改源码即可配置组合能力，且每次运行都有追加式会话日志，支持恢复、分叉、搜索和重放。运行模式分标准、代码、最小、创作者四种。
本质是产品发布公告，无数据论证或行业分析，信息含量低。

en.thesis: DeepSeek Harness opens its developer preview with an 'everything is a plugin' architecture, emphasizing composability and traceability.
paragraphs: DeepSeek has released the Harness developer preview, claiming that every capability—models, tools, skills, conversations, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and UI—can be swapped out as an interchangeable plugin, built on the Cordis plugin system.

The architecture lets developers configure and combine capabilities without altering source code, and every run generates append-only session logs that support resumption, forking, searching, and replay. There are four run modes: standard, code, minimal, and creator.
Essentially, this is a product launch announcement with no data-driven arguments or industry analysis, so its informational content is low.

articles.title: Codex in ChatGPT desktop app for Linux is now in preview
articles.author: allanrbo

zh.thesis: Linux 用户现在可以预览 ChatGPT 桌面应用及 Codex，这是平台扩展的重要一步。
paragraphs: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 桌面应用推出 Linux 预览版，支持 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex。这标志着 OpenAI 首次正式支持 Linux 桌面。
对于依赖 Linux 的开发者而言，可以在熟悉的环境中直接使用 Codex 和浏览器工作流，无需再切换到其他操作系统。

en.thesis: Linux users can now preview the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex, marking an important step in the platform's expansion.
paragraphs: OpenAI has announced that the ChatGPT desktop app is now available in preview for Linux, supporting ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. This marks the first official support for Linux desktops by OpenAI.
For developers who rely on Linux, this means they can now use Codex and browser workflows directly in their familiar environment, without needing to switch to another operating system.

zh.thesis: 「Gloomberb」这一标题本身不包含明确论点或信息，仅为模糊命名。
paragraphs: 由于文章正文缺失，仅有标题「Gloomberb」可用。该词无确切含义，无法判断内容领域或核心观点。
作为摘要，只能基于模糊性给予低分，因为缺乏可总结的实质内容。

en.thesis: The title 'Gloomberb' carries no clear thesis or information, being merely an obscure label.
paragraphs: Since the article's full text is missing, only the title 'Gloomberb' is available. The word has no definite meaning, making it impossible to determine the subject area or core argument.
As a summary, it can only receive a low score based on its vagueness, given the lack of substantive content to distill.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank becomes first foreign yuan clearing bank in Europe
articles.author: Markoff

zh.thesis: 德意志银行成为欧洲首家人民币清算行，标志着人民币国际化在欧洲的推进。
paragraphs: 这是德意志银行获得中国人民银行授权，在欧洲开展人民币清算业务。这有助于提升人民币在欧洲的使用，便利中欧贸易和投资。
但作为一则新闻简讯，缺乏深入分析和数据支持，对普通读者而言信息增量有限。因此评分较低。

en.thesis: Deutsche Bank becomes Europe's first yuan clearing bank, advancing the internationalization of the yuan in Europe.
paragraphs: This marks Deutsche Bank's authorization by the People's Bank of China to conduct yuan clearing business in Europe, which is expected to boost the use of the yuan in the region and facilitate trade and investment between China and Europe.
However, as a brief news item, it lacks in-depth analysis and supporting data, offering limited additional insight for the general reader, hence its low rating.

zh.thesis: 美国的一个事实，但来源未明，内容未详。
paragraphs: 此文为链接分享，未提供实质内容，仅指出来源。
读者无法获取信息，仅知是一个事实，但具体如何无从得知。

en.thesis: A fact about the United States, though the source is unidentified and the content is unspecified.
paragraphs: This entry is a link share that provides no substantive content, merely pointing to a source.
Readers are left without information, knowing only that it is a fact, but with no way to learn what it actually is.
